name: Arena Breakout [ALPHA]
desc:
THE GAME HAS BEEN APPROVED BY THE OFFICIAL ARENA BREAKOUT DEVS AND MODERATORS SO IT WILL NOT BE TAKEN DOWN.

This game still in an ALPHA State which mean all features are still WIP and some are not even done yet. This game is Inspired by the original game called Arena Breakout which is a First Person Extraction Shooter for Mobile and PC. 

You hopped into a raid, you fight enemies and loot them or be sneaky and get all the loots from surrounding environtments. Remember, Loot or Be Loot.

SHOOT LOOT AND TIME TO SCOOT.

Fully Mobile Supported

SHUTDOWN = WIP
